speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing fatigue and difficulty concentrating; to understand the cause of these symptoms and your abnormal blood findings, I need to ask you a few questions. Can you tell me when these symptoms first started and if they have been getting worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pernicious Anemia

The patient's history of smoking, combined with fatigue, dizziness, and digital pain that improves with cold (suggesting acrocyanosis or Raynaud's phenomenon), strongly points towards a vitamin B12 deficiency. I will request the results of a CBC and serum B12 levels to confirm this suspicion.
